module: Third-party library: LuaJIT's jit.zone (Mike Pall), copyright 2005-2016, MIT license. Implements a simple model of hierarchical zones (a stack of names) used by the LuaJIT profiler (mode z of profiling_p) to group samples by named zone. The module returns a callable table: zone('name') pushes a zone, zone() pops it.
usage:
local zone = require('extensions/profiling/zone')
zone('AI')
  zone('A*')
  print(zone:get()) --> 'A*'
  zone()
print(zone:get()) --> 'AI'
zone()
notes: Popping an empty stack triggers the error "empty zone stack" (assert).
The module is not a game extension: it is loaded by require on this path (the original example cited require('jit.zone')).
No M function: the API is the returned table (methods flush and get, plus the __call metamethod).

flush.desc: zone:flush() completely empties the zone stack.

get.desc: zone:get() returns the current zone (top of the stack), or nil if the stack is empty.
